from pathlib import Path
import geopandas as gpd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

REPO = Path.cwd().resolve().parents[1] if Path.cwd().name == '09_grid' else Path.cwd().resolve()
while not (REPO / 'configs/za/za_2023_fixed_validation.yaml').exists() and REPO != REPO.parent:
    REPO = REPO.parent
DATA_AUDIT = REPO / 'data' / 'za_audit'
DATA = REPO / 'data'
CONFIG = yaml.safe_load((REPO / 'configs/za/za_2023_fixed_validation.yaml').read_text())
RUN = CONFIG['run']['name']
PYPSA_RSA = Path(CONFIG['pypsa_rsa_root'])

level_lock = pd.read_csv(DATA_AUDIT / 'za_spatial_level_lock.csv')
osm_summary = pd.read_csv(DATA_AUDIT / 'za_pypsa_earth_osm_grid_summary.csv')
corridors = pd.read_csv(DATA_AUDIT / 'za_rsa_interregional_transfer_limits.csv')
reconciliation = pd.read_csv(DATA_AUDIT / 'za_grid_reconciliation.csv')
plant_bus = pd.read_csv(DATA_AUDIT / 'za_plant_bus_assignment.csv')
demand_bus = pd.read_csv(DATA_AUDIT / 'za_demand_bus_attachment.csv')
coverage = pd.read_csv(DATA_AUDIT / 'za_custom_busmap_coverage.csv')
busmap = pd.read_csv(DATA / 'custom_busmap_elec_s_34.csv', index_col=0).squeeze()
busmap.index = busmap.index.astype(str)

regions_34 = gpd.read_file(PYPSA_RSA / 'data/bundle/supply_regions/rsa_supply_regions.gpkg', layer='34').to_crs('EPSG:4326')
regions_34['region_id'] = regions_34['LocalArea'].astype(str).str.strip()
existing_lines = gpd.read_file(DATA_AUDIT / 'za_rsa_existing_lines_220kv_plus.geojson')
level_lock

Map 1 — Custom busmap (simplified PyPSA-Earth buses coloured by 34-region assignment)¶

In [3]:
n = pypsa.Network(str(REPO / f'networks/{RUN}/elec_s.nc'))
buses = n.buses[['x', 'y']].copy()
buses.index = buses.index.astype(str)
buses['region'] = busmap.reindex(buses.index).values
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 10))
regions_34.plot(ax=ax, edgecolor='black', facecolor='lightgrey', linewidth=0.4)
buses_assigned = buses.dropna(subset=['region']).copy()
ax.scatter(buses_assigned['x'], buses_assigned['y'],
           c=pd.Categorical(buses_assigned['region']).codes,
           cmap='tab20', s=20)
ax.set_title(f'Custom busmap coverage — {len(buses_assigned)} simplified buses → {buses_assigned["region"].nunique()} of 34 regions')
ax.set_xlabel('Longitude'); ax.set_ylabel('Latitude')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

Map 2 — ≥220 kV existing lines on 34-region supply layer¶

In [4]:
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 10))
regions_34.plot(ax=ax, edgecolor='black', facecolor='whitesmoke', linewidth=0.4)
voltage_colours = {220: '#1f77b4', 275: '#2ca02c', 400: '#ff7f0e', 765: '#d62728'}
for v, colour in voltage_colours.items():
    subset = existing_lines[(existing_lines['DESIGN_VOL'] >= v - 5) & (existing_lines['DESIGN_VOL'] <= v + 5)]
    if not subset.empty:
        subset.plot(ax=ax, color=colour, linewidth=1.2, label=f'{v} kV')
ax.set_title('PyPSA-RSA ≥220 kV existing lines on Eskom 34-region layer')
ax.legend(loc='lower left'); ax.set_xlabel('Longitude'); ax.set_ylabel('Latitude')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

top_corridors = corridors.sort_values('st_clair_n1_mw', ascending=False).head(30)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 8))

ax.barh(labels, top_corridors['st_clair_n1_mw'])

Bar — Plant capacity per region (Module 09 back-fill)¶

In [6]:
plant_per_region = (
    plant_bus.dropna(subset=['assigned_region'])
    .groupby('assigned_region')['Capacity_MW'].sum()
    .sort_values(ascending=True)
)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 9))
ax.barh(plant_per_region.index, plant_per_region.values, color='steelblue')
ax.set_xlabel('Installed capacity (MW)')
ax.set_title('custom_powerplants.csv capacity per 34-region (Module 09 assignment)')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
